CommunityApplications.Profile:
Unraid template for **Eidon**, a self-hosted AI platform with a team of agents, and a chat for everything else. Bring your own model keys; your data stays on your server.
This repository only holds the Unraid template. The app, its documentation and its issue tracker live at [github.com/Quack6765/Eidon-AI](https://github.com/Quack6765/Eidon-AI). Please report problems there.
